raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43148

When `<tool_call>` starts mid-chunk, `HermesDetector.parse_streaming_increment` returns the text before it directly. Every other normal-text path goes through `_clean_normal_text`, which drains `_normal_text_buffer`, so text held back as a possible `</tool_call>` comes out after the tool call. The same branch leaks `</tool_call>` into the content when one parallel call ends and the next starts in one delta:

```
                 before                              after
issue repro      ['a', 'b', '', '', '</done']        ['a', '</b', '', '', 'done']
parallel calls   ['', '', '', '</tool_call>\n', '']   ['', '', '', '\n', '']
```

## Modifications

- Route that branch through `_clean_normal_text`, as suggested in the issue.
- Two streaming tests in `test_hermes_detector.py`, one per symptom. Both fail on `main`.

## Accuracy Tests

Parser-only change, no model output involved.

```
pytest test/registered/unit/function_call/test_hermes_detector.py    # 14 passed
pytest test/registered/unit/function_call                            # 631 passed
pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/function_call/hermes_detector.py test/registered/unit/function_call/test_hermes_detector.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not affected.

files.patch:
@@ -105,7 +105,9 @@ def parse_streaming_increment(
         if bot_pos > 0:
             normal_text = current_text[:bot_pos]
             self._buffer = current_text[bot_pos:]
-            return StreamingParseResult(normal_text=normal_text)
+            return StreamingParseResult(
+                normal_text=self._clean_normal_text(normal_text)
+            )
 
         result = super().parse_streaming_increment(new_text="", tools=tools)
         if result.normal_text:

@@ -172,6 +172,45 @@ def test_streaming_text_then_tool_call(self):
         params = json.loads(full_params)
         self.assertEqual(params["city"], "Tokyo")
 
+    def test_streaming_held_back_text_keeps_order_across_tool_call(self):
+        # "</" is held back as a possible "</tool_call>"; it must come out
+        # before "b", not after the tool call.
+        detector = HermesDetector()
+        chunks = [
+            "a</",
+            "b<tool_call>",
+            '{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Paris"}}',
+            "</tool_call>",
+            "done",
+        ]
+        all_normal_text = ""
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            result = detector.parse_streaming_increment(chunk, self.tools)
+            all_normal_text += result.normal_text
+
+        self.assertEqual(all_normal_text, "a</bdone")
+
+    def test_streaming_end_tag_not_leaked_between_parallel_calls(self):
+        detector = HermesDetector()
+        chunks = [
+            "<tool_call>",
+            '{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Paris"}}',
+            "</tool_call>\n<tool_call>",
+            '{"name": "search", "arguments": {"query": "food"}}',
+            "</tool_call>",
+        ]
+        all_calls = []
+        all_normal_text = ""
+        for chunk in chunks:
+            result = detector.parse_streaming_increment(chunk, self.tools)
+            all_calls.extend(result.calls)
+            all_normal_text += result.normal_text
+
+        self.assertNotIn("</tool_call>", all_normal_text)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [c.name for c in all_calls if c.name], ["get_weather", "search"]
+        )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     import unittest
